items.title: Know the identity behind the role: Authorize and audit with trusted identity propagation
items.summary: Today, AWS is making it easier to grant access and audit activity based on the user or workload (a non-human caller, such as an application, service, or an automated workflow) behind an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role. Trusted identity propagation (TIP) carries the identity of the user or workload with each AWS request, […]
